simple.meaning: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גָּרַשׁ (H1644) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 47 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גָּרַשׁ (gârash) means to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce First listed occurrence: 1Chr 17 21.

definitions.short: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
definitions.usage: cast up (out), divorced (woman), drive away (forth, out), expel, × surely put away, trouble, thrust out.
